speaker: Doctor
text: The asymmetry of your symptoms, specifically the clumsiness on the right side, is a crucial detail. Have you experienced any recent headaches, dizziness, or changes in your speech or vision?

text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
